events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45; he would have been 80 in 2026.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable showman, Freddie Mercury, who we lost on this day in '91. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles Release "Rubber Soul"
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropping in '65. A pivotal album that showed just how much they were evolving.

events.title: John Lennon Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of musical icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 in 2026.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who we lost far too soon on this day in 1980. His legacy of peace and incredible music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie would have been 80 years old today.

angles.name: Bowie's Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and genius of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true innovator who constantly redefined music and style.
